Earlier this year, Satechi launched a line of Mac accessories in colors inspired by the MacBook Neo. Now, the company is back with a new expansion of that line with four new accessories:

  • MacBook Neo OntheGo 45W GaN Charger with 60W Max $30
  • MacBook Neo Core USB-C to 4K HDMI Adapter $30
  • MacBook Neo Slim EX1 Wireless Keyboard $50
  • MacBook Neo Form Desk Mat $40

New Satechi gear designed to match MacBook Neo

The new 45W charger uses a dynamic power system that delivers up to 60W at plug-in and 45W sustained. It can charge a MacBook Neo at full speed and fast-charge an iPad.

Here’s what else Satechi is launching today:

  • Core USB-C to 4K HDMI Adapter: A compact, sleek, and premium adapter that brings 4K at 60Hz to any display with no drivers or delay.
  • Slim EX1 Wireless Keyboard: Quiet, low-profile scissor keys and a durable metallic finish bring precision and simplicity to your workspace. Its thoughtfully crafted form saves space while keeping a natural typing feel.
  • Form Desk Mat: An expansive surface with plenty of room for a keyboard, mouse, notebooks, and everyday essentials. It doubles as a mouse pad, and an anti-slip base keeps it firmly in place.

The new gear is available to order starting today on Amazon. It’s all available in the same silver, indigo, blush, and citrus options as the MacBook Neo. As we approach the holiday shopping season, this could be a great gift for anyone in your life with a MacBook Neo.
